avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing escitalopram levels and efficacy; increases serotonin synthesis independently
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; allow 2-week washout before or after escitalopram initiation

avoid_supplements.name: Serotonergic supplements (5-HTP, L-tryptophan, SAMe)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive serotonergic activity increases risk of serotonin syndrome (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, altered mental status)
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid without medical supervision

avoid_supplements.name: Linezolid
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent monoamine oxidase inhibitor activity combined with SSRI leads to serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; alternative antibiotics should be considered

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild serotonergic activity and antiplatelet effects; may potentiate bleeding risk if combined with other anticoagulants
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for bleeding symptoms; use with caution at standard doses

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids (high doses >3g/day)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Antiplatelet and anticoagulant effects; SSRIs may increase bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor bleeding risk; standard supplementation (≤2g/day) generally safe

caution_supplements.name: Valerian root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and mild serotonergic activity
caution_supplements.action: Counsel on increased sedation risk; monitor for excessive drowsiness

avoid_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Escitalopram has minimal MAOI activity; tyramine interaction risk is very low but theoretical
avoid_foods.action: No strict restriction required; standard dietary advice applies

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase escitalopram levels, though escitalopram is not primarily metabolized via CYP3A4
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor for increased side effects (QT prolongation at high doses)

caution_foods.name: Caffeine (high intake >400mg/day)
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS stimulation and potential serotonergic potentiation; may worsen anxiety or insomnia in sensitive patients
caution_foods.action: Counsel moderation; monitor for increased anxiety or sleep disturbance

monitoring_notes: Escitalopram carries FDA warning for QT prolongation at doses >20mg/day, particularly relevant with CYP2C19 inhibitors. Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms, bleeding risk (especially with anticoagulants/antiplatelet agents), and hyponatremia during first 2 weeks of therapy.
